name: Pinball Arcade: Terminator 2 - Judgment Day
storyline: Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991) is unquestionably one of the greatest pinball tables of all time. Designed by the legendary, Steve Ritchie and based on the hit movie starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, it includes several features that have become pinball standards. It was the first Williams table designed to use a Dot Matrix Display and the first to have a Video Mode feature. It was also the first to feature a swing out Cannon that can be fired by the player using a specially designed Gun Grip Ball Launcher. With its dramatic music score, staggering light and sound effects, breathtaking graphics and speech from the one and only Arnold, this table brings the thrills and suspense of T2 to life...and then some. 15,202 units of this table were produced.
